title: Auxiliary proof coordinates in the composed proof
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and query count $r$, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ use $K$ auxiliary coordinates per seed. For every input word $w$, original proof $p$, seed $s$ of $V$'s verifier, and auxiliary coordinate $q<K$, the composed proof at the coordinate indexed by $(q,s)$ in its added block equals the Boolean encoding of the $q$th coordinate of the local auxiliary witness chosen for $w$, $p$, and $s$.
